question.text: An MII must ensure that its primary/first empaneled ODR Institution is:

answer.text: Not empaneled as the primary/first ODR Institution with any other MII

explanation.text: The Logic: An MII must ensure that its primary/first ODR Institution is not the primary/first ODR Institution of any other MII. The Trap: An ODR Institution may still be empaneled with multiple MIIs in some role, but it cannot be the primary/first ODR Institution for more than one MII at the same time. Note: The primary/first ODR Institution restriction applies on a per-MII basis and is the only condition stated in the source for this question.
